doc: Authorization role. The Super Master Role is identified by UUID matching METRI_MASTER_ROLE_ID (env var). Its cross-tenant access level (READ_ALL vs FULL) is defined by METRI_MASTER_ROLE_SCOPE (env var). NO field in this model influences cross-tenant authorization — all security-critical decisions are based on immutable env var constants evaluated in-process by CedarAuthorizer.

domain.description: The target domain: e.g., work_order, asset.

actions.description: Allowed actions: VIEW, CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, EXECUTE, EXPORT.

scope.description: Visibility scope: ALL (global tenant), OWN (created by user), ASSIGNED (assigned to user).

attributes.name: allowed_locations
attributes.doc: Contextual Authorization: List of locations (physical boundaries) this role is authorized to access.

attributes.name: allowed_assets
attributes.doc: Contextual Authorization: List of specific assets this role is authorized to access.
